missing.title: That market is not here any more
missing.text: It may have been removed. Open it again from the markets list.

field.name: Market name
field.lngHint: Or drag the pin. Map data comes from OpenStreetMap.

images.hint: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 8 MB each. Add up to {{max}} photos; the first one becomes the cover photo.
images.uploadInProgress: Wait for the photos to finish uploading, then save.

pin.label: Pin the market
pin.note: Drag the pin to the market entrance. Stalls pin themselves inside the market later.

toast.fix: We marked what still needs your attention.

closures.title: Closed days
closures.intro: A day this market does not open, even though it falls on an operating day. Customers see it on the market page and on the home board, and no new orders can be placed for it.
closures.added: Closed day added. Publish an announcement so customers see it.
closures.removeText: The market opens again on that date and customers can order for it.

field.reasonPlaceholder: Ward street works on Quốc Hương
field.handling: Orders already placed for that day

empty.title: No closed days
empty.text: This market opens on every one of its operating days. Add a closed day when it will not.

move.title: Move the orders to the next market day
move.short: moved to the next market day
move.text: Each customer keeps their order and gets the new pickup date. The stall has to be selling that day too.

contact.title: Ask each stall to contact its customers
contact.text: Nothing changes automatically. The stall arranges another time and refunds nothing, because no money has changed hands.

cancel.title: Cancel the orders and tell the customers
cancel.text: Stock goes back to the stall and the order ends as cancelled, not declined, because the stall did nothing wrong.

error.days: Pick at least one operating day.
error.close: The closing time must be after the opening time.
error.images: Add at least one photo of the market.
